changelog:
v0.5.1
- Separate Marshmello module identity, folder, blueprint and API to avoid official-store collisions
- Requires Jellyfin plugin 0.5.1 and the new Jellyfin Connector - Marshmello module
- Preserve existing requests, subscriptions and durable download receipts
- Test coexistence with official connector routes on modern and legacy MediaForge interfaces
